name: 6PM -trilogy-
source:
In a certain city, in a certain park, there is a hospital. The hospital's origin is unknown, but it is now run by the self-proclaimed Genius Doctor Agatha, and her young servant assistant Percival.

Between the hours of 7am to 5:59PM, the hospital sees your run-of-the-mill human patients. But come 6PM, a very supernatural cast of clientele arrive...

[From [url=https://verdimand.itch.io/6pm-trilogy]Itch.io[/url]]
